notes: A validly signed interpreter renamed svchost.exe in C:\Users\Public reads the WAM token cache and Credential Manager. svchost.exe is listed as an owner of both stores (O_TOKENBROKER, O_WINCRED) and is_trusted_owner() checks only the file name and 'not untrusted' (any valid signer, any non-Temp folder).
known_gap: is_trusted_owner matches 'svchost.exe' (O_TOKENBROKER / O_WINCRED) by name with any valid signer outside Temp
